state.objective: Determine why browser blocks POST requests from app.domain.com to api.domain.com.

context.content: 2026-10-03T12:00:00Z OPTIONS /v1/checkout HTTP/1.1 response: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * but Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true; browser rejects credentials with wildcard origin

submitted_answer.answer: The credentialed POST is blocked because the API returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * while also allowing credentials. Configure CORS with the explicit origin https://app.domain.com instead of a wildcard.
